ops.title: why metal's nix-darwin daemons died on every reboot (the /nix-volume race) and the layered fixes that make reboots self-heal
ops.body:
metal's `org.nixos.*` LaunchDaemons used to come up DOWN after every reboot (exit 78,
penalty-boxed) until manually kicked. Root-caused 2026-06-27; layered fixes (all in
`darwin/metal.nix` + `scripts/setup.sh`, committed `bae5404`/`b4dc9f6`/`609c91f`/`c92b434`):

1. **The real cause: the `/nix` APFS volume mount race.** `/nix` is a SEPARATE Determinate-Nix
   APFS volume (`/dev/disk3s7 on /nix`) mounted LATE at boot. RunAtLoad daemons win the race and
   try to exec their `/nix/store/…` program before `/nix` is mounted → launchd "could not execute
   program" (access errno 2) → exits the service **78 via xpcproxy** → "respawning too quickly"
   penalty box → stays down. The wrapper never even runs (so foreground/post-boot always worked,
   which misleads). **Fix: a `waitNix` trampoline on the LOCAL root volume** (`/usr/local/lib/yclaw/
   metal-wait-nix`, written by preActivation) prefixed onto EVERY daemon's ProgramArguments; it
   blocks until the real `/nix` program is `-x`, then `exec "$@"`. No fast-fail → no penalty box →
   reboot self-heals. Verified: all daemons up on their own after a cold reboot.

2. **Wrapper preamble (`mkDaemonPreamble`)** handles the LATER races once the daemon runs: launchd
   gives daemons an unset HOME + root's inaccessible CWD (`/var/root` 700) → Python daemons (omlx,
   mlx-audio) crash on `~`/import-time `os.getcwd()` (exit 78); plus tart's virtiofs auto-mount +
   sops `/run/secrets` decrypt aren't instant. Preamble pins HOME + cd, waits for shares + secrets.

3. **Shares are ONE `AppleVirtIOFS` automount** at `/Volumes/My Shared Files` (the per-share paths
   never appear in `mount`); test readiness with `[ -e <share> ]` (triggers + verifies the
   on-demand mount), NOT a `mount | grep` of the subdir path.

4. **`setup.sh write_agent` launchctl race:** `bootout` is async — wait for the label to drain from
   the domain before `bootstrap`, else EIO ("5: Input/output error") aborts `just setup` mid-run.

Ops gotchas: recovery is **`bootout`+`bootstrap`** (resets the penalty box) — `kickstart` does NOT
clear a deep penalty box. Detached darwin-rebuild on metal: use **`launchctl submit`** (`nohup`/
`setsid` fail over `tailscale ssh` — no controlling tty / no setsid on macOS); `/tmp` is wiped on
reboot. In-guest `darwin-rebuild`/`nixos-rebuild` from the host-owned repo share needs `git config
--global --add safe.directory` for root (libgit2 ownership check) — codified in metal-redeploy +
scripts/redeploy.sh. Related: [[redeploy-in-place-2026-06]], [[metal-headless-gui-session]],
[[deploy-pipeline-fixes-2026-06]].
